reasoning: The agent shows at least one decisive, well-reasoned structural pivot (dropping the liquid crate for a custom engine) plus a genuine toolchain strategy switch, with rebuild/re-test afterward — clearly above the symptom-patching of anchor 3 and the case-by-case fixes of anchor 5, matching anchor 8's 'recognize structural divergence and swap the approach, re-verifying.'
